_metadata.description: OT-P0-003 — honest gaps registry with qualitative notes/approaches.

requirements.title: gaps registry persists and surfaces qualitative notes/approaches per gap
requirements.description: The gaps command/RPC surfaces every known gap with notes/approaches/context (not just a percentage). Cross-cutting/global gaps and explored-but-unbuilt ideas are persisted in SQLite and surfaced via `gaps [--projection] [--cell]`.

validation.notes: API: SQLite store round-trips notes/approaches; target api/internal/gaps.
CLI: gaps list/filter output; target cli/domains/gaps.
E2E: gaps surfaced with qualitative context.

requirements.title: append explored approaches to a gap (the store-our-thinking write verb)
requirements.description: `gaps note <id> --add "<approach>"` appends an explored-but-unbuilt idea/approach to a gap, and `gaps show <id>` returns the full gap with its accumulated notes/approaches. The one focus write verb; lets the team durably store thinking on a known gap without implementing it.

validation.notes: API: AddGapNote appends + GetGap round-trips; target api/internal/gaps.
